purpose: Define the one supported Financial Writing execution path used by the user: ChatGPT invokes the Financial owner, current GitHub main supplies code/rules and durable article state, and exact-stage capabilities are providers inside that path rather than alternate execution modes.

execution.rule: Every publishable Financial Writing request enters this owner path. Exact-stage capabilities are handshaken only as needed; availability may block an affected stage but never selects a second business-state authority or permits free-form article completion.
execution.provider_rule: Model, web, deterministic/Python, document and any future attested review facilities are capability providers inside one owner trajectory. No provider may create a parallel article state store, alternate workflow, alternate terminal semantics or alternate route selector.

task_contract.single_mode_override_rule: A direct distribution-mode override requires USER_EXPLICIT_OVERRIDE plus distribution_mode_override_evidence that is an exact substring of the original user prompt and is persisted in the INIT receipt.
task_contract.integrity_rule: Any non-empty required_outputs supplied by deserialization or another caller must exactly equal the canonical set derived from distribution_mode; mismatch fails closed.

workflow.mutation_rule: Normal stage advancement/revision/terminalization uses financial_writing_agent/owner_guard.py; BLOCKED recovery and system-impact lifecycle use financial_writing_agent/owner_lifecycle.py. All mutations operate against freshly read main state and require authoritative reread after write.
workflow.review_fail_rule: A recoverable review FAIL must be persisted through owner_lifecycle.block_review_failure_state with a canonical revision_target valid for the failed review stage. The target is bound into the blocking action receipt and may not be invented later.
workflow.blocked_recovery_rule: owner_lifecycle.resume_blocked_state requires non-empty repair evidence, reuses the persisted canonical recovery target, invalidates that target and every downstream artifact/review/delivery identity, and resumes only on that target.
workflow.system_impact_rule: owner_lifecycle.review_system_impact_state classifies material corrective evidence. SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED remains open until immutable diagnosis plus maintenance_ref, validation_refs and assurance >= REGRESSION_VERIFIED are supplied; closure remains self-attested unless stronger exact-action provider evidence actually exists.
workflow.semantic_assurance: CHAT_SELF_REVIEW unless stronger provider-attested evidence is actually present for that exact review action

checkpoint_contract.migration_rule: Existing main article STATE.json using the GITHUB_CHAT token remains readable. The token must never be used to choose an execution route. New control-plane names and paths are owner-neutral. A future state-schema migration may rename the token only with backward-compatible migration and regression proof.
checkpoint_contract.mutation_conflict_rule: Every material mutation binds the freshly fetched STATE.json blob SHA and writes with the same SHA. Universal lease/epoch fencing remains a separate required outer invariant and is not proven by blob CAS alone.
checkpoint_contract.post_write_verification: Reread STATE.json and every newly referenced artifact from main before claiming COMMITTED.

legacy_quarantine.legacy_owner_runtime_code: May remain temporarily only where dependency cleanup has not yet completed. Current Skill/manifest/capability/task handoff/package discovery/default tests must not route new or resumed business work through it.
legacy_quarantine.fallback_rule: No legacy mechanism may become active merely because the current capability set is incomplete. Missing capability blocks the affected stage.

anti_bypass: No publishable final article is produced before a durable article STATE.json exists on main.
No alternate owner-native/plugin/SQLite route may be selected for new Financial business work.
No chat executor may silently change the canonical distribution mode or required-output set.
No Research/Editorial/Title/Draft stage is completed without a durable artifact ref.
No review FAIL is recoverable without a persisted canonical repair target and repair evidence.
No BLOCKED recovery preserves stale target/downstream evidence.
No OPEN or MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED system-impact obligation is erased without deterministic lifecycle review/closure evidence.
No DELIVERY advancement is accepted with a missing applicable article Word output.
No FINAL terminalization is accepted until the complete required_outputs set including AUDIT_DOCX is present.
No per-article business-state branch is created or resumed as current authority.
No historical eval, maintenance branch, chat summary or deprecated runtime store overrides current main authority.
No missing capability authorizes free-form writing.
